keySentence: Colin believed he was too weak to live.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Colin cried and got angry. He thought he would die. Mary told him he was not weak. Colin believed he was too weak to live.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Colin spent his days crying and shouting at everyone around him. He truly believed that he was too sick to ever get better. Colin believed he was too weak to live a normal life. Mary refused to feel sorry for him like everyone else did. She told him he was just scared, not actually sick at all. For the first time, someone challenged Colin to be brave.
